content.short: Gnosis Protocol is a DEX trading protocol for Ethereum using batch auctions to provide MEV protection and best prices.
content.description: Gnosis Protocol is a fully permissionless DEX trading protocol for Ethereum, currently in version 2 (GPv2). It uses batch auctions to deliver MEV protection and tight slippage without depending on the relative order of transactions. GPv2 aggregates liquidity from a range of DEX sources to present traders with the best available prices, enabling efficient, transparent swaps. The combination of batch execution and cross-DEX liquidity integration helps minimize front-running risk and improve price execution for users.
